$comment: mergeQueue.refreshOnUnsatisfiedWorkflows (on|off): when GitHub's merge queue refuses a green PR because required workflows are not satisfied (runs older than the ruleset), the drain refreshes the PR onto main once per head so fresh runs count, then enqueues it. off leaves the PR failing to enqueue. Env override: WE_MERGE_QUEUE_REFRESH_ON_UNSATISFIED_WORKFLOWS.
